name: The Shops at Terrell
summary: The Shops at Terrell is a Tanger Outlets shopping center featuring a variety of brand-name and designer outlet stores in Terrell, Texas. This open-air outlet destination offers exceptional value shopping with convenient hours and a customer-focused experience for Dallas-Fort Worth area shoppers.
demographics: The Shops at Terrell attracts value-conscious shoppers from the Dallas-Fort Worth metropolitan area, particularly families and bargain hunters seeking designer and brand-name merchandise at outlet prices. The trade area draws from Terrell's local population as well as visitors traveling along Interstate 20, with a customer base that includes middle-income households looking for quality products at discounted prices. The center serves as a regional outlet destination for East Dallas suburbs and Kaufman County residents, appealing to shoppers who prioritize value and are willing to drive for significant savings on name-brand merchandise.
description: The Shops at Terrell is a premier outlet shopping destination located at 301 Tanger Drive in Terrell, Texas, offering shoppers access to a diverse collection of brand-name and designer outlet stores. As part of the renowned Tanger Outlets chain, this shopping center provides customers with exceptional value on quality merchandise from their favorite brands, all in a convenient open-air setting. The center prioritizes customer experience and safety, with facial coverings recommended for unvaccinated guests and a strong commitment to the well-being of teams, stores, and shoppers alike. With operating hours from 10:00 AM to 8:00 PM, The Shops at Terrell serves as a one-stop shopping destination for the Dallas-Fort Worth area and beyond, featuring customer service amenities and a welcoming atmosphere. The center maintains an active social media presence on Facebook, keeping shoppers informed about the hottest deals, new store openings, exciting giveaways, and special events throughout the year.
